name: @educateos/fleet
description: EducateOS fleet protocol (roadmap R01): allow-listed wire messages, Ed25519 signed envelopes, the district-side agent with key rotation and recovery, a reference root instance registry that the commercial system must vouch for, and the district's offline entitlement cache. Its `./ops` entry point is the signed admin ops protocol (SCHO-263); its `./durable-object-store` entry point is the agent's Durable Object SQLite sequence counter. A library, not a deployable Worker.
